chose: LLM observability via manual $ai_generation capture through posthog-node, not @posthog/ai's OTel PostHogSpanProcessor
over: @posthog/ai OpenTelemetry NodeSDK integration for Vercel AI SDK
because: OTel path requires ai@^5/6 pinning (v7 removed ai.* spans), drags NodeSDK+resources into a Node-native-TS worker, and is untestable blind; a hand-built properties object is a pure function agents can unit-test without LLM or PostHog access

chose: LLM classification is a new llm-enrich step in the existing recipe-enrichment workflow, always enqueued by enrich, with the PostHog flag gate evaluated inside the step
over: async classifier inside the existing Classifier[] array
because: Classifier type is pure/sync by contract; same-workflow step reuses the queue, pool, backfill idioms, and lets the fail-closed flag no-op cheaply instead of gating enqueue at N call sites

chose: label ownership split by method prefix: writeEnrichment's delete becomes rules-scoped, llm writer replaces only llm:% rows; safety-asymmetric merge (LLM never downgrades a rules contains/may_contain or excluded)
because: user chose second-opinion + safety-asymmetric; label PK is (recipe,dimension,slug) so unscoped delete-all would erase the other provider's rows on every rerun
